ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.18 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.18: 70 playable powers toward the 100-ability goal, including delayed blasts, damage reflection, healing fields, teleportation, summoned companions, temporary barriers and area defenses. Requires Harmony. Experimental RimWorld 1.7 mod; use a test save.
